svg.title: Four kinds of sample
svg.desc: Four shaded panels showing an air sampling pump with a spore trap cassette, a tape lift on a surface, a bulk sample cut from plasterboard and a dust sample, each with what it shows.
svg.text: 15 L/min × 5 min = 75 L = 0.075 m³. 96 spores ÷ 0.075 = 1,280 spores/m³ indoors, against 320 outdoors:
4 times higher. Check the fraction of the trace counted, and compare room by room.
None of them replaces inspection and moisture readings.
CARSI · Level 3 Mould Remediation · schematic, not to scale
